dlink_progression: Defeat enemies while linked and collect that link’s emblem. The first and second emblems raise the link to levels 1 and 2, expanding its deck and granting the listed abilities; level 2 unlocks an enhanced finisher. Later emblems refill the gauge. Published decks and emblem probabilities are indexed except Pete’s unknown probabilities.
exclusions: Vanitas: temporary final battle D-Link, not ordinary persistent acquisition
usage: Activate only with a full D-Link gauge; activation restores HP. The linked deck temporarily replaces the equipped deck. Revert, leaving the room or opening the menu ends the link. Additional emblems at level 2 refill the gauge. D-Links cannot be activated with temporary allies or in Terra’s Eraqus/Terra-Xehanort battles.
